BACKUP_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket used to store workspace Snapshots between runners.

BACKUP_BUCKET_NAME.description: Use the same name as the `BACKUP_BUCKET` R2 bucket.

CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID where pipeline deployments are created.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID where this CI Worker, Workflow, and backup bucket run.

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared secret used to verify GitHub webhook deliveries.

CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token used by pipeline deployments. Create one from the [API Tokens page](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens).

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: R2 access key ID used by Sandbox to save workspace Snapshots.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: R2 secret access key used by Sandbox to save workspace Snapshots.
